verdict.rationale: Capacities documents daily notes uniquely linked to each day, a calendar Day view, and an "Open today" command. A community user praises its daily-notes implementation, and generic object templates can prefill properties and blocks. However, the evidence never says templates apply to daily notes, never says the note is created automatically, and never says it is the default landing page. Missing for 10: documented template pre-fill specific to daily notes, explicit automatic creation of each day's note, daily note as the default landing view on open.
